evidence: Read FractionCompareW end to end. Visible text is only the prompt, "{num}/{den}" bar captions, "They're equal", and an sr-only "You chose the first bar, 3/4." status. describeState.ts:857 returns null for this type, so the "Describe this model" disclosure (and its actions copy) never renders.

Read FractionEntryW end to end. Field names are "whole number", "numerator", "denominator", plus "negative sign" and spec.unit; the live preview bar is aria-hidden. Only extra text is the GhostChip gated on tone==="info" (reveal, out of active/retry scope). Not present in describeState.ts.

Read FractionGridW end to end. Slider labels "row count", "shade in rows", "column count", "shade in columns" and the readout "{a}/{b} x {c}/{d} -> overlap n/m" are all mathematical. describeState.ts:849 narrates rows/columns/overlap only; actions copy at 937 describes the four sliders.

Read FractionOfSetW end to end. Visible text: prompt, "{n} of {setSize} chosen", "({den} equal groups of {perGroup})", slider label "how many". Reveal rings are tone==="info" and aria-hidden. Not in describeState.ts.

Read FunctionMachineW end to end. Box captions "input", "rule", "middle", "then", "output"; table headers "Input"/"Output"; readout "(target {targetOutput})". All mathematical/instructional. Not in describeState.ts.

Active-state counter renders "{revealed.length} valid geometric state{s} inspected; {spec.requiredExplorations} required before grading." - an exploration-action tally against an authoring quota (requiredExplorations) that names the grading system. Reinforced in the learner-facing disclosure: describeState.ts:385 returns "${spec.task.replaceAll(/([A-Z])/g," $1")}: ...", i.e. the internal task discriminant (coordinateProof/perimeterMissing/aaSimilarity) de-camelized and printed as the leading label. Stage cards also print "Stage {n}" and "Exact state: {value}".

Read GraphReadW end to end including all three modes (tally/picture/bar). Visible text: prompt, spec.categoryLabel, "(no marks at all)", numeric scale buttons, "Tap the number the graph shows.", and the tone==="info" counting hint. describeState.ts:157 narrates the display only.

The "How to change it" copy rendered inside the learner's "Describe this model" disclosure (WidgetRenderer renders actionsFor whenever describeWidgetState is non-null; graphStoryLab returns non-null at describeState.ts:418) reads "... and reveal draws a separate dashed target without overwriting learner work." - internal render-phase and program vocabulary ("reveal", "learner work") describing the authoring system rather than the mathematics or the controls. Secondary: widgets.tsx:7314/7325 render "Graph segment stage bank", "Assembled story stages", "No stages assembled yet.", "Back one stage" and 7276 "Add story stages to draw the graph." - "stage" used as engine vocabulary for graph segments.

Read GraphZoomW end to end. Visible text: prompt, "x = {a}", "magnification x{n}", "from the left y -> ... from the right y -> ...", buttons "zoom in"/"zoom out"/"the limit exists"/"no limit". describeState.ts:605 narrates sides and verdict only. All calculus vocabulary.

Read HundredthsGridW end to end (tenths and hundredths modes). Visible text: prompt, column numerals, "{n}/{total} = {dec}", "shaded = {n} ({prefilled} given)". Reveal boundary is tone==="info" and aria-hidden. Not a describeState case, so its actions entry at 936 never renders.

Read IntegerChipsW end to end. Visible text: prompt, "{pos} + (-{neg}) = {sum}", "({n} zero pairs cancel)", "positive chips"/"negative chips", "Add a zero pair"/"Remove a zero pair", and "A +1 chip and a -1 chip change the representation but preserve the value." - the last is mathematical prose about equivalence, not representation metadata. Not in describeState.ts.

Read InversePipelineW end to end. Visible text: "What f does to x", "Build f-1: undo it, last step first", "Steps you can use", "undo" badge, "Slot {n}" accessible names, and the arithmetic check sentence. describeState.ts:514 speaks the forward chain and the built track. All function-composition vocabulary.

Read the router plus both branches (LengthDifferenceW and LengthPickAlignW, covering pick and align modes). Visible text: "how many more?", "start line", "Starting ends lined up - the compare is fair.", "{n} units past the start line", "Each stripe is one {unit} - count them if it looks close." Not a describeState case, so its actions entry at 934 never renders.

Read LineExploreW end to end including the MMIP morph/undo layer. Visible text: prompt, "y = mx + b", "run"/"rise" triangle labels, "slope m"/"intercept b", the two lock chips ("Slope is resting for a moment - it already matches..."), and "Undo last move". The transaction sentence at 12653 is sr-only and describes the mathematical move. describeState.ts:592 is purely the line and its target.

Active state renders a permanent readout tile "moves" showing "{moves}/{spec.requiredMoves}" (LabReadout label="moves"), i.e. a running count of learner actions against an authoring-set move quota - process telemetry, not mathematics. The same telemetry is spoken in the learner disclosure: describeState.ts:311 ends "... ${v.moves} meaningful moves recorded." and the actions copy at describeState.ts:932 advertises "live readouts name the relation, angle, and move count." The sibling "relation" and "angle" tiles are legitimate.

Read MatchPairsW end to end. Visible text: prompt, "Tap one on the left, then its match on the right. Tap a numbered one to unlink.", link numerals, and the live paired-claim list. Reveal arrows are tone==="info" and aria-hidden. Not in describeState.ts.

Read MatrixTransformW and its MatrixStepper helper. Visible text: "i-hat lands at (a, c)", "j-hat lands at (b, d)", the matrix bracket display, and "det = a*d - b*c = n -> area xn". spec.targetName is an authored human phrase (schema.ts:2837 "e.g. a 90 degree counter-clockwise rotation"), not an internal token. describeState.ts:176 is purely linear-algebra. NOTE (not a focus leak): the actions copy at describeState.ts:941 says "Four sliders" but the controls are +/- steppers.

Read McqW end to end. The only rendered strings are spec.prompt, option labels, and the tone==="info" reveal badges "correct answer"/"your answer" (aria-hidden, reveal phase only). No authoring metadata; the seeded-shuffle rationale lives in comments, never on screen. Not in describeState.ts.

Read MixedRegroupW and MRBars end to end (convert/add/subtract modes). Visible text: "Wholes"/"Parts"/"Whole column"/"Parts column", "Make a whole ({den} parts -> 1)", "Break a whole (1 -> {den} parts)", the exchange narration messages, "Undo"/"Reset". All unit-exchange vocabulary. Not in describeState.ts.

Read MoneyBoardW end to end (count, compose and change modes). Visible text: coin denominations, "Tap coins to count them - biggest first is fastest.", receipt rows "Paid"/"Cost"/"Change", "Total", and an sr-only "target {n} cents". describeState.ts:814 and the actions copy at 935 are both coin/arithmetic language.

Read NetFoldW end to end. Visible text: prompt, per-face areas, "2(lxw) + 2(lxh) + 2(wxh) = SA", "(target {targetSurfaceArea})", and slider labels "prism length/width/height". describeState.ts:776 narrates the box and its net. Stating the target surface area is goal framing, not authoring metadata.

Read the router and both branches (HopSizeW and HopLandingW). Visible text: "hit"/"skipped" tick captions, LabReadouts "stride" and "marks hit" ({k} of {n} - a property of the mathematical object, not an action tally), "hop size", "This stride lands on every mark - can a bigger one still do it?", "start at X -> land on Y". Not in describeState.ts.

Read NumberLinePlaceW end to end including the fraction-denominator path. Visible text: tick labels, "mark {n} of {den}", "distance from 0: {v}", slider label "marker". Error chevron and reveal ghost are tone-gated and aria-hidden. Not in describeState.ts.

Read the whole module (it is the engine's only render path; widgets.tsx:16418 just dispatches). Visible text: "ray runs toward larger/smaller numbers", "turn it round", "endpoint included"/"endpoint left out", the solved form plus interval, "Test a value"/"test the endpoint", the membership sentence, and "Undo last move". The transaction "notice" at 655 is sr-only and mathematical. describeState.ts:876 returns relation text plus the solution sentence only.
Read NumericW end to end. Rendered strings are spec.prompt, spec.unit, and the tone==="info" GhostChip "Correct: {answer}". Nothing else. Not in describeState.ts.

Read OddEvenPairsW end to end. Visible text: "{t} tens = {5t} full pairs - tens ALWAYS pair. Only the ones matter:", "Pair two", "even"/"odd", "{n} pairs made - keep pairing." / "One chip left over with no partner." / "Every chip found a partner." describeState.ts:859 returns null so the disclosure never renders.

Read PercentBarW end to end. Visible text: prompt, axis percentages and their values, "{pct}% of {whole} = {amount}", slider label "percent". The "target" tick is tone==="info" and aria-hidden. Not in describeState.ts.

Read PercentChangeLabW end to end: "Base price", "Your final-price claim", "base"/"selected" bar captions and the "{base} +/- {amount} = {claim}" strip are all commerce/mathematics. Two judgement calls recorded, neither classed as a leak: (1) line 5518 renders the raw spec discriminant {spec.direction} as a visible bar label, but its values are the real words "markup"/"markdown"; (2) the disclosure actions copy at describeState.ts:945 ends "The chosen claim remains visible on reveal." - mild render-phase vocabulary, weaker than the graphStoryLab case.

Read PlaceCompareW end to end (chart, blocks and expanded views). Visible text: place-name headers ("ones"/"tens"/"hdths"...), the digit cells, the </=/> buttons, and the tone-gated hints "look at the {place} place" / "the {place} place decided it" / "every place matches". All base-ten vocabulary. Not a describeState case.

Read PlaceValueW end to end. Visible text: "100x{h} + 10x{t} + {o} = {total}", "(target {target})", slider labels "hundreds"/"tens"/"ones". The "{n} short of"/"{n} past" chip is tone==="info" and aria-hidden. Not in describeState.ts.

The learner-facing accessible description opens with "Base-ten task ${spec.task}." - the raw camelCase authoring enum is printed verbatim (schema task values include e.g. divisionFirstMove, placeExponent, exponentChain), so a learner hears "Base-ten task divisionFirstMove." It continues with "{n} of {m} derived stages inspected" (process telemetry). On the active screen, widgets.tsx:6956 renders "{revealed.length} valid base-ten stage{s} inspected; {spec.requiredExplorations} required before grading." Actions copy at describeState.ts:953 adds "reveal uses a separate ghost and never overwrites your work."

Read PlotPointW end to end. Rendered text is only spec.xLabels/yLabels (or "column {n}"/"row {n}" fallbacks) and the dots; ghost rings are tone==="info" and aria-hidden. describeState.ts:498 reports marked cells and "{k} of {n} targets are marked so far" - a property of the mathematical selection, not an authoring tally.

Read PointEntryW end to end. Visible text: prompt, the delimiters and comma, the typed values; accessible slot names are spec.slotLabels or "first value"/"second value". Mini-grid is aria-hidden. Only extra text is the tone==="info" GhostChip. Not a describeState case.

The learner-facing accessible description opens with "Point-set task ${spec.task}." - the raw camelCase authoring enum printed verbatim, then "{n} of {m} exact states inspected." On the active screen, widgets.tsx:6971 renders the stage grid with "Stage {n}" kickers, "Closed - activate to derive this point-set state.", "Exact state: {value}", and the counter "{revealed.length} valid state{s} inspected; {spec.requiredExplorations} required before grading." - an exploration tally naming the authoring quota and the grading system.

Read PolarTraceW end to end (rose and limacon modes). Visible text: "r = cos({v}theta) -> {n} petals", "n is odd -> n petals", "r = {v} + 2cos theta -> a dimpled limacon", slider labels "n, inside the cosine" / "a, the constant out front". The "target" marker is tone==="info" and aria-hidden. describeState.ts:483 is pure polar-curve prose.
Read ProbabilityAreaW end to end. Visible text: prompt, "{n}/{total} = {decimal} ({reduced})", slider label "shaded = {n}". Target staircase is tone==="info" and aria-hidden. Not in describeState.ts.

Active state renders "{validRevealed.length} proportional check{s} completed; {spec.requiredExplorations} required before grading." - a tally of learner reveal actions against an authoring quota that names the grading system. Same telemetry in the learner disclosure at describeState.ts:365: "${explored} proportional checks have been opened; ${spec.requiredExplorations} are required." Actions copy at describeState.ts:952 additionally describes the authoring design ("The initial view never states proportionality or the final result... and reveal uses a separate ghost without replacing learner work."). Also renders "percent stage: {n}%" and "Build stage {n}: {label}".

Read QuadDragW end to end. Visible text: side lengths on edges, "right now it is {quadName}", "sides ... - diagonals ...", the midsegment readout, slider labels "corner across"/"corner up". Target polygon is tone==="info" and aria-hidden. describeState.ts:462 names pinned vertices and spec.targetName (an authored human phrase).

Read the router plus both forms (QuadraticRootsW and QuadraticVertexW). Visible text: factored/expanded equation, LabReadouts "discriminant b2 - 4ac" and "real solutions", slider labels "first root"/"second root"/"leading coefficient a" and "a (stretch/flip)"/"h (left/right)"/"k (up/down)". describeState.ts:217 handles both forms in pure algebra.

Active state renders "Task mode: {spec.task.replaceAll(/([A-Z])/g, " $1").toLowerCase()}." - the internal authoring task discriminant (schema.ts:5907 enum: remainderContext, invalidRemainder, decimalClassify, repeatToFraction, ...) printed to the learner as "Task mode: invalid remainder." It sits under a "Source state" kicker (7177). The disclosure is worse: describeState.ts:416 returns "Exact quotient task ${spec.task}." with the raw camelCase token unmodified. Also renders "Stage {n}", "Exact state: {value}" and "{revealed.length} exact state{s} inspected; {spec.requiredExplorations} required before grading." (7198).

Read RadicalCheckW end to end. Visible text: "the SQUARED equation: x + {n} = x2", "the ORIGINAL equation: sqrt(x + {n}) = x", the two satisfied/not-satisfied lines, "this candidate passes the squared equation and FAILS the original", slider label "the candidate x". All extraneous-root vocabulary. Not in describeState.ts.

Read RatioTableW end to end. Visible text: the table caption "Equivalent ratio table", spec.colA/colB headers, the row values, and "missing value = {b}". The strategy/reversal instrumentation is emitted through onEvent only and never rendered. Not in describeState.ts.
